# Nano Banana Canvas

> Visual AI workflow builder for creators and teams. Build, share, and run multimodal workflows from prompt to storyboard.

## What is Nano Banana Canvas?

Nano Banana Canvas is a cloud-based visual AI workflow builder that lets users design, connect, and execute multimodal AI pipelines through an intuitive drag-and-drop canvas interface. It supports GPT Image 2, FLUX, Midjourney-style models, video generation, and more — all orchestrated visually without writing code.

## Key Features

- **Visual Workflow Canvas**: Drag-and-drop node editor powered by ReactFlow. Connect AI models, prompts, and tools into executable pipelines.
- **Multi-Model Support**: GPT Image 2, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter, FLUX, and more. Switch models per node.
- **Cloud Execution**: No local GPU required. All workflows run on cloud infrastructure.
- **Template Marketplace**: Browse, fork, and share community workflows in the Explore hub.
- **Credit-Based Pricing**: Free tier with daily sign-in credits. Subscription and one-time credit packs available.
- **Multilingual**: English and Chinese interfaces with full i18n support.
- **Real-Time Collaboration**: Share workflows with team members and the community.

## Use Cases

- AI image generation pipelines (prompt → image → upscale → output)
- Storyboard creation with sequential AI image generation
- Ad creative workflows combining text and visual AI
- Video analysis and generation pipelines
- Multi-step AI content production (blog → image → social post)

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS
- Deployed on Cloudflare Workers for global edge performance
- Uses Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), R2 (storage), and KV (cache)
- Authentication via Clerk, payments via Stripe

## Comparison

| Feature | Nano Banana Canvas | ComfyUI | Midjourney |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cloud-based | Yes | No (local) | Yes |
| Visual workflow | Yes | Yes | No |
| Multi-model | Yes | Stable Diffusion only | Midjourney only |
| No GPU needed | Yes | No | Yes |
| Free tier | Yes | Free (self-hosted) | No |
| API integration | Yes | Community | No |
